title: wlim33/vox-ocean
abstract: Real-time voxelized FFT ocean for macOS and iOS — Metal + SwiftUI, C++20

cited_by.name: Sphere-Clamped Voxel Neighbor Search finds the closest occupied voxel cell to a query point within a spherical radius, constrained to the grid boundaries [S1, unofficial]. It differs from [Point-in-Box Inclusion Test](1400-point-in-box-inclusion-test.md) by returning the nearest neighbor rather than a binary occupancy result, and from [3D Filled Circle Kernel Generation](1520-3d-filled-circle-kernel-generation.md) by performing a runtime search for a specific query point rather than precomputing a static kernel [G]. It serves as the spatial lookup primitive for [PBF Displacement Calculation with Grid-Based Neighbor Search](9026-pbf-displacement-calculation-with-grid-based-neighbor-search.md) [G].
